correctness.rationale: The root-neighbour-clique and first-geodesic-neighbour characterization proves exact rooted automorphism orbits. The wavefront induction fixes the unsplit boundary at each t; q-2 intra-shell counts establish layer-one recovery, and the deletion-deck sum (k-1)k_vector recovers all higher profiles one round after distance. Theorem implies sharp d-1 versus d stabilization, and generating functions count classes. Standalone full-graph and weighted-quotient verifiers pass; finite checks are not the proof.

value.rationale: The family is canonical in product graph theory and finite-model counting refinement. The explicit all-round partition, stable orbit count and sizes, and sharp single-round shift caused by unequal factor sizes answer natural structural/algorithmic questions; they are not a tiny finite enumeration or arbitrary parameter slice. The predecessor-deck invariant gives a reusable proof mechanism.
